verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe two browser-operation modes. Cowork's built-in browser lets Claude open sites, read pages, click, type and fill forms while you watch. The Claude in Chrome extension lets Claude read, click and navigate websites alongside you, and computer use extends this to general screen control. Together these cover both researching and completing tasks on websites. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that browser tasks complete reliably, and deeper documentation of limits and supported task types.
